description: Source code for a pretty formatter class used in the behave testing framework, including terminal support, color formatting, and various formatting methods for test output.

classes.name: MonochromeFormat
classes.description: Class for formatting text without color (monochrome mode).

classes.name: ColorFormat
classes.description: Class for formatting text with color based on status.

classes.name: PrettyFormatter
classes.description: Main class for formatting test output with color and structure, extending Formatter.

methods.name: get_terminal_size
methods.description: Detects terminal size, with special handling for Windows.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Formats text without color (MonochromeFormat).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Formats text with color based on status (ColorFormat).

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PrettyFormatter with stream, config, and state variables.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state variables.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Sets the current URI and resets state.

methods.name: feature
methods.description: Handles start of a feature, printing header info.

methods.name: rule
methods.description: Handles start of a rule.

methods.name: scenario
methods.description: Handles start of a scenario.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Adds a step to the current scenario.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Handles a step match, printing the step in execution.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Handles step result, printing output based on status.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Handles end of feature/scenario, flushing output.

methods.name: _print_current_scenario_captured_output
methods.description: Prints captured output for current scenario if any.

methods.name: _finish_current_scenario
methods.description: Finalizes current scenario, printing steps and captured output.

methods.name: _finish_current_rule
methods.description: Finalizes current rule.

methods.name: _finish_current_feature
methods.description: Finalizes current feature.

methods.name: replay
methods.description: Replays the current statement and steps.

methods.name: arg_format
methods.description: Returns format for argument based on key.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns color or monochrome format object for a given key.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Prints a table with proper formatting.

methods.name: doc_string
methods.description: Prints a doc string block.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Returns formatted text with color based on status.

methods.name: indented_text
methods.description: Returns indented text with optional proceed logic.

methods.name: calculate_location_indentations
methods.description: Calculates indentation levels for source locations.

methods.name: print_statement
methods.description: Prints the current statement header.

methods.name: print_steps
methods.description: Prints all steps.

methods.name: print_step
methods.description: Prints a single step with formatting.

methods.name: print_tags
methods.description: Prints tags for a feature or scenario.

methods.name: print_comments
methods.description: Prints comments.
